note: Names no information system. IIEP-UNESCO says (activities before July 2023) that Niger lacks a reliable school database, that school statistics, assessment results and quarterly reports are passed up the administration and archived, input is manual, some data is held only as averages per inspection, and local actors cite no computer or electricity; it does not say outright that learner records are on paper only. Shawara Karatu itself is communal data-review days tried in two municipalities, not a system.
